title: Beams, Rainbows, and Depth: Post-Processing a Mountain Lightscape (AK Fall 2-1)
summary: This video presents a studio-style walkthrough of assembling and post-processing a dramatic landscape image built around sunbeams and a distant mountain. The presenter discusses shot selection, cropping to isolate the core elements, expanding dynamic range, then building the image in a zone-based workflow using brushes to apply local adjustments. Key steps include whites-driven light restoration, color calibration to enhance fall colors, and color separation in the foreground, followed by depth layering with dehaze, meticulous cloning to remove distractions, and a panoramic crop for a two-rainbow scene. The guide also contrasts manual blending with AI-based tools and emphasizes atmosphere and timing as essential ingredients, concluding with final color grading and edge refinements. The content blends practical Photoshop/Camera Raw techniques with field photography considerations and on-set decision-making about framing and light.
topics: atmosphere as a driver of processing

sections.title: Frame selection and dynamic range expansion
sections.description: Identify the strongest beam separated from the mountain, crop to emphasize the key elements (beam, opening in sky, mountain, and trees), and begin expanding the tonal range to reveal detail in shadows and highlights.

sections.title: Zone-based painting workflow
sections.description: Develop a workflow that targets multiple tonal zones with localized adjustments. Use brushes to apply different corrections to each zone and utilize the history brush to revert or refine as needed, maintaining control over the final balance.

sections.title: Rainbows framing and panoramic framing
sections.description: Discusses the framing effect of two rainbows and the choice to crop and adjust the sky to amplify the rainbow highlights, emphasizing compositional strategies for expansive scenes.

sections.title: Manual blend and foreground removal
concepts: manual layering to remove foreground clutter
sections.description: Demonstrates aligning two shots with the same focal length and using a hard-edge brush/clone stamp to merge layers, removing distracting elements (foreground bush) for a believable composite.

sections.title: Color separation, dehaze, depth layering, and sky foreground balance
sections.description: Explains color separation in fall foliage to create distinct color planes, followed by depth-building through dehaze and layered adjustments. Demonstrates selective color to modulate greens/yellows, then uses dehaze and selective brightening to push the background further away while maintaining foreground impact. Ends with targeted sky adjustments (color grading and luminance) and careful foreground balancing to preserve contrast.
